title: Experience helps meet another turn
meaning: Changes to shared actions draw on understood experience and are emotionally felt as a movement of circumstances that cannot be fixed permanently.
text: The Wheel of Fortune appears in two different positions in this Energy Field. In the physical position, the card concerns changing shared actions when conditions turn; in emotions, it describes feeling that changeability itself, as familiar stability gives way to unfolding events. The Hermit in energy motivates you to draw on understood experience and recognise what both people already know. The overall tone involves attentive adjustment: earlier understanding informs your actions, while the next turn still produces a living, potentially mixed response.

For example, the room available for your shared club changes again. You remember how you organised the materials last time and carry part of that solution into the new conditions. Meanwhile, the new address brings both interest and frustration at yet another change. **Our earlier experience helps us act, but it cannot make circumstances stand still.** A practical solution does not remove the emotional feeling that your common rhythm has to be assembled afresh.

Tension appears if experience is used as a promise of complete predictability. Another change then seems to disprove everything you had understood. The opposite extreme is to treat changeability as a reason to learn nothing from what happened before. Two Wheels do not mean doubled luck; they distinguish an actual revision of action from the emotional experience of impermanence.
